content.rendered:
We had a great start to kick of the new school year. It was fun filling the building up with the excited energy of the students. We have some new information to share in the Middleton Update that you can read HERE.

On Thursday, September 21, we will host Back To School Night fom 6:00 – 7:30 pm. We will begin with a presentation from the principal in the cafeteria. Following this, each classroom will offer two, 25 minute session. This is a time for parents to visit the classroom and learn about the curriculum that will be covered in their child’s class this year.
